lines.en: Listen! Do you hear that sound?
Yes, Grandma. Is it a bird?
I think so. Look out the window.
I see it! It's on the tree.
What a sweet voice. It is not loud.
Did it sing this morning too?
Yes. I heard it when I woke up.
I noticed a nest there last week.
Nice. We will find it together tomorrow.
Thank you, Grandma. I love this view.
lines.ko: 고마워요, 할머니. 이 경치가 정말 좋아요.

dialogs.about: 텔레비전 소리가 너무 커 할아버지에게 부탁

lines.en: The television is too loud. Can you turn it down?
lines.ko: 텔레비전 소리가 너무 커요. 좀 줄여 줄래요?

lines.en: Sorry. I can't hear the news well.
Do you hear my voice now?
Yes, I hear you. Is this sound okay?
Yes, that's good. Thank you.
I turned it up this morning. I forgot.
I noticed that when I came home.
I will keep it low next time.
Thank you. Was the news good?
Yes. Come and sit. Let's watch it together.
